mapper.select: /* JournalDreamMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT dream.id, dream.created_by, dream.journal_chapter_id, chapter.journal_day_id, dream.sort_order, day.yy AS yy, day.mnth AS mnth FROM journal_dream dream LEFT JOIN journal_chapter chapter ON dream.journal_chapter_id = chapter.id LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON chapter.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE dream.id = #{id}
/* JournalDreamMapper.findAllForReorder */ SELECT dream.* FROM journal_dream dream WHERE dream.journal_chapter_id = #{journalChapterId} AND dream.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY dream.sort_order
